The island formula computes the fine-grained entropy of Hawking radiation.

## Page curve

$S(R) = \min \operatorname{ext}_I \left[ \frac{\text{Area}(\partial I)}{4 G_N} + S_{\text{matter}}(R \cup I) \right]$
